correctness.rationale: The true survival convention and full-support model are specified. Exact hazard sign reduction to D_n, a positive entire-series coefficient sign split, strict variation of the positive-to-negative series ratio, a triangular-kernel MLR comparison of adjacent age integrals, and a rescaled central-difference asymptotic prove all-age uniqueness, strict staircase and limit for all positive real parameters. Boundary beta=1/2 and n=0 singular derivative are explicitly handled. The second-derivative factorization was independently checked symbolically from actual check_hazard.py; sampled finite-index roots and signs passed; no finite experiment substitutes for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact sharp shape-and-scale phase boundary decides an established discrete reliability law’s hazard behavior over all infinitely many ages, replacing parameter plots. A strictly decreasing one-root-per-age threshold staircase determines the unique minimum-age window and proves that the possible reversal is only decreasing-to-increasing. Its asymptotic constant quantifies large-age resolution and is useful for calibration; q invariance separates the generator intensity from hazard shape.
